newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Regent Pacific HK share trading due May 19.
newsitem.headline: Regent Pacific HK share trading due May 19.

text.p: Hong Kong trading house Regent Pacific Group Ltd said on Monday its initial public offering would run from May 6-9 and dealing in the shares was expected to begin on May 19.

Net proceeds from the issue will be used to expand its business in the U.S., to establish a new fund management group, to acquire a financial house in Europe, and to further expand into emerging markets, it said.
The group provides investment management and advisory services in emerging markets to institutional and professional investors worldwide.
